accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Hampala macrolepidota visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. Sebarau follows Hampala macrolepidota in Nick Baker's field photograph and the supporting specimen image. Commons image 251680991 was excluded after its high-body silhouette conflicted with the primary reference; its caption is not treated as identification evidence.
